candidates.change: The existing public card structure can become a reusable schema-level operation; evidence does not date this capability.
candidates.obstruction: A prefix policy must come from the agreed identifier rule.
candidates.outcome: Produce the required editorial fields while keeping the research decision intact.
candidates.route: Infer column projection, strict typing and first-segment extraction; reject malformed batches.
candidates.scale: Independent rows can be processed in batches subject to tested resource bounds.
candidates.test: Apply the map to unseen cards and one invalid batch; preserve order, title and status.

candidates.value: Could reduce repetitive editing when formats recur; maintenance and review are unpriced.

candidates.alternative: Generate a portable program from paired example rows.
candidates.obstruction: A naïve projection might emit nulls for missing fields.
candidates.outcome: Obtain a machine-readable queue from the same approved records.
candidates.route: Use an explicit strict filter over every row and the exact four requested fields.
candidates.scale: One pass per batch; external users need jq plus the filter.
candidates.test: Check output and error parity on the same cases.
candidates.title: Run the editor’s jq transformation
candidates.value: A credible low-cost self-service choice for an editor already comfortable with jq.

candidates.alternative: Local projection without modifying upstream publication.
candidates.change: The register already has a canonical source.
candidates.obstruction: Upstream maintenance ownership and authorization are absent.
candidates.outcome: Eliminate repeated downstream conversion by providing the editorial view as part of the source release.
candidates.route: Propose an additional versioned export to the source owner with content-equivalence checks.
candidates.scale: Amortized delivery across subscribers with clear schema versions.
candidates.test: Independently reconstitute the required current queue from a generated view.
candidates.title: Publish the editorial view at source
candidates.value: Reusable for many consumers; changes impose maintenance and change-coordination costs.

candidates.change: No documented frontier change is necessary for a three-card selection.
candidates.obstruction: Repeatability, invalid-batch refusal and ordered output are difficult to enforce by hand.
candidates.outcome: Prepare a small queue with manual verification of every status.
candidates.route: Use a verified import and a reviewed four-column export.
candidates.scale: Per-row operator review grows with the number of records.
candidates.test: Time one full handoff including corrections.
candidates.title: Map the records in a review worksheet
candidates.value: Minimal startup effort may win for one use; complete operator time matters.

candidates.alternative: Use a simple unit test on the current export and review diffs.
candidates.change: Source-stable records permit a before/after comparison in principle.
candidates.obstruction: Only one revision is in the packet.
candidates.outcome: Detect whether a future revision still supplies the expected input and preserves decisions.
candidates.route: Collect another authorized source snapshot and compare the migration contract with a retained reference.
candidates.scale: One check per source revision with recurring review for changes.
candidates.test: Evaluate a real later schema change on held-back rows.
candidates.title: Establish a schema-change acceptance gate
candidates.value: Potentially reduces future silent drift; usefulness depends on another release.
